function_declarations.name: goal_to_plan
function_declarations.description: Turn a vague/ambiguous ask into an agent-ready plan — the "quality of the brief" discipline an AI-native team runs on. Emits a spec_charter (mission · scope · ONE acceptance criterion · risks) + a ready-to-dispatch lane brief (role · owned files · acceptance · report protocol), chaining the premortem + sprint-scaffold skills. Use when the user says "plan this", "turn this into a brief", "scope this out", "make this agent-ready", "what's the plan for X", "goal to plan", "/goal-to-plan", or before dispatching a lane / starting multi-step work from a fuzzy goal.

acceptance.description: the one objective, testable bar that defines done

scope_out.description: something explicitly out of scope for now; repeatable

skill.description: an installed skill the agent should use; repeatable

tool.description: a concrete surface the agent will touch (CLI, API, DB, endpoint); repeatable

context.description: a file, directory, or note the agent must read; repeatable

deny.description: a path or area the agent must not touch; repeatable

verification.description: how the bar is proven in-product

role.description: one-line role for the dispatch block

owned_file.description: a file the agent owns exclusively (the file-lock contract); repeatable

report.description: what to report back and when (default: on green, or on the first blocker)

write.description: also save the brief to this path (directories are created)

json.description: emit the two artifacts as JSON
